items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was that Peter Davis or another man? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, this fellow Ben did, what I'm talking about

ctx.x: Same way with Louis Armstrong. Louis Armstrong was in the home. My cousin gave Louis Armstrong his first trumpet in the home. He was in charge of the boys out there. And he gave Louis Armstrong, Trump started Louis with trumpet. Now who is that?
Was that Peter Davis or another man? It was a man that died last year, two years ago.
No, this fellow Ben did, what I'm talking about, he was a valto.
